answeredQuestions.target-users: Compliance analysts, frontline reviewers, policy owners, operations managers, audit and governance teams
answeredQuestions.jobs-to-be-done: Review evidence, compare against policy, identify gaps and exceptions, prepare cases for human decision-making, and preserve traceability
answeredQuestions.workflow-boundaries: Decision support workflow, not autonomous adjudication; final decisions remain with a human reviewer
answeredQuestions.risk-and-escalation: Low-confidence, contradictory, or high-risk cases route to escalation instead of auto-approval

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: The scenario is a compliance-check workflow supported by an LLM with human accountability, traceability, auditability, and escalation requirements.
The likely value is faster case preparation and consistency; AI guardrails require source-grounding, escalation, audit logs, and sensitive-data minimization.
This is workshop evidence only; keep the artifact synthetic and treated as a draft for downstream product framing.
